name: Current regime
derivation: Two medians, fitted independently. Train breadth 0.4, 0.6 gives index round(0.5 * 1) = round(0.5) = 0 under banker's rounding, so the cut is 0.4. Train volatility 0.01, 0.03 gives the cut 0.01 by the same rule. STRONG is breadth > 0.4, LOUD is volatility > 0.01. The four queries name one quadrant each, and the fifth confirms a missing input yields no label rather than a default quadrant.
note: expected is the fitted cuts first (breadth then volatility), then one label per query
